raw: {"questions": [{"question": "Where does photosynthesis mainly take place in leaf cells?", "options": {"A": "Mitochondria", "B": "Chloroplasts", "C": "Nucleus", "D": "Ribosomes"}, "answer": "B", "explanation": "Photosynthesis takes place mainly in the chloroplasts of leaf cells, which contain chlorophyll."}, {"question": "What is produced during the light-dependent reactions of photosynthesis?", "options": {"A": "Glucose and oxygen", "B": "Carbon dioxide and water", "C": "ATP and NADPH", "D": "RuBisCO and starch"}, "answer": "C", "explanation": "The light-dependent reactions produce ATP and NADPH along with releasing oxygen."}, {"question": "In which part of the chloroplast do the light-independent reactions (Calvin cycle) occur?", "options": {"A": "Stroma", "B": "Thylakoid membranes", "C": "Outer membrane", "D": "Inner membrane"}, "answer": "A", "explanation": "The light-independent reactions occur in the stroma of the chloroplast."}, {"question": "Which enzyme fixes carbon dioxide during the Calvin cycle?", "options": {"A": "Amylase", "B": "ATP synthase", "C": "RNA polymerase", "D": "RuBisCO"}, "answer": "D", "explanation": "Carbon dioxide is fixed by the enzyme RuBisCO during the light-independent reactions."}, {"question": "Which of the following factors affects the rate of photosynthesis?", "options": {"A": "Nitrogen concentration", "B": "Light intensity", "C": "Oxygen concentration", "D": "Soil pH"}, "answer": "B", "explanation": "Light intensity is listed as a factor that affects the rate of photosynthesis along with carbon dioxide and temperature."}, "warnings": []}
